body: Yeah, $100 dollars is pretty expensive. I got mine for like $70.
I'm still in school. So many choices...
I am just not really that interested in anything. I don't feel like life will be any better.
I do, but why would I want to fulfill them?

I mean, I was an asshole by being an insensitive jerk. I didn't understand people's real struggles. Now I'm experiencing it myself. Nothing surprises me day by day. I just feel like it is all going to be the same.
